storage_remediation.public_repository_policy: Upload only OPEN-SOURCE-MANIFEST.json; do not publish raw candidate shards or sample excerpts.
storage_remediation.private_repository_policy: Full staging and sample-review artifact may be uploaded only when github.event.repository.private == true.
storage_remediation.sample_log_policy: review_candidate_samples.py writes its sample file locally but prints summary counts only; no raw text to Actions logs.
storage_remediation.push_trigger_policy: Acquisition no longer runs on push; scheduled and workflow_dispatch runs acquire, while pull_request runs validation only.
storage_remediation.historical_exposure: The artifact 13737479716 has GitHub metadata expiry 2027-02-08. Raw excerpts also appear in the job log; the exact log-retention expiry was not checked. Neither artifact nor log was deleted.
storage_remediation.public_candidate_storage_gate: Public repository requires HERETIC_STAGING_PASSPHRASE with at least 32 characters before any candidate payload is downloaded. Without it, acquisition is skipped and a zero-byte blocked_storage_gate manifest is published.
storage_remediation.public_encryption: When the secret is configured, candidate payloads and sample excerpts are packaged and encrypted with GPG AES-256, SHA-512 S2K (65,011,712 iterations) and integrity protection before public artifact upload; plaintext candidate files are deleted from the runner.
storage_remediation.private_storage: Private repositories may upload the bounded raw candidate tranche as a private Actions artifact.
storage_remediation.required_secret: HERETIC_STAGING_PASSPHRASE (high-entropy random passphrase of at least 32 characters; never store in Git or print in logs)
storage_remediation.encrypted_artifact_policy: Encrypted artifact remains publicly downloadable ciphertext; only holders of the passphrase may decrypt. Record artifact SHA-256 and keep the passphrase outside the repository.
storage_remediation.group_rotation_fix: Scheduled group index uses ((day_of_year - 1) * 4 + tranche_slot) modulo group_count so four daily slots cover all eight groups exactly once in each 48-hour cycle.
